caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be a metallic or ceramic clasp, rendered in shades of beige, tan, and brown. It consists of a central circular or oval ring, from which two symmetry-opposing structures extend outward. Each extension curves slightly outward and downward, featuring folds and curves that resemble ribbons or bands. On each side, near the center, decorative elements shaped like small flowers or rosettes are attached, with additional bundled or knotted details close to the ring. The object displays gradual shading and soft highlights, emphasizing its three-dimensional form. Below the object, lightly printed and centered, is the text “ROSE CAMPBELL GRAYE.”
title: Horse Hobble
